description:
## [2.0.14](https://github.com/nobianh78/tada-patches/compare/v2.0.13...v2.0.14) (2026-10-22)

### ✨ Features & Improvements

* **Instagram Rebranding & Complete TADa Transformation:**
  - Renamed preference fragment to `TadaPreferenceFragment`.
  - Replaced all user-visible 'HushGram' mentions across settings, cards, toasts, and dialogs with 'TADa'.
  - Updated Vietnamese localization table (1100 keys) with natural Vietnamese for all new TADa strings.
  - Updated clone patch defaults to `com.instagram.android.tada` and 'TADa Instagram'.
